about_the_game:
Goremon is a tactical RPG with turn-based combat, creature collection, and narrative decisions that directly affect the development of the world. In a universe where Goremons are the source of energy and conflict, you'll train your team, face other trainers, and make choices that shape your destiny. Each Goremon has unique abilities and traits, and you’ll explore a world full of mysteries and dangers, solving puzzles and overcoming challenges to progress through the story.

What’s included in this demo?

  • The beginning of your journey as a trainer in a world full of secrets.

  • Choose your first Goremon: each has a unique set of skills and combat style.

  • Tactical turn-based battles with speed mechanics, status effects, and deep strategy.

  • Intriguing characters, opposing factions, and choices that shape your path.

  • Exploration, dialogue, and hints of a complex and evolving world. Interact with characters, trade Goremons, and change the course of their stories.

Turn-based tactical battles

  • Fight to become the top-ranked trainer in your Region’s Federation!

  • Choose who deserves to join your team. Use up to 6 Goremons per battle.

  • Speed determines how many actions you can perform each turn.

  • Custom status system for advanced strategy.

  • Play at your own pace—fight outside of arenas or in official competitions.

Features

  • Capture over 100 unique Goremons.

  • Level up and evolve your team.

  • Fully playable with both controller and keyboard.
